text:
Sam (AE): Heads up — GlossyBank SIG v2 is due Thursday COB. They want question-by-question evidence for ~30 Qs, priority: key management (Q12), logging/retention (Q21), data residency (Q45). I attached spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood.com/glossybank/sig_qna.xlsx Can we collect artifacts + short narrative by Friday EOD? @Tina (SecOps) @Raj (SRE)
Lee (Sales Eng): I can draft the narratives for logging and residency. Need exact filenames for artifacts.
Tina (SecOps): For KMS: we rotate CMKs every 90 days; docs: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/kms-rotation.md Also control evidence: rotation-policy.pdf and Key Rotation Logs (KMS-rotations-2025-01.zip. I'll upload.
Raj (SRE): I'll pull CloudTrail and S3 access logs for their requested window. Will scrub customer identifiers, provide redacted logs + script redact_logs.py.
evidence-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/glossybank/1777770000/kms-rotation-manifest.json (access restricted)
Sam (AE): Perfect. Small ask: GlossyBank wants confirmation that keys are customer-isolated in Dedicated instances. Short line to confirm?
Tina (SecOps): Yes — we have customer-dedicated KMS keys for Dedicated customers; confirm text: 'Dedicated deployments use tenant-scoped CMKs managed in customer VPC/KMS or dedicated HSM; keys are not shared across tenants.' I'll add that to narrative.
Lee (Sales Eng): I'll compile the spreadsheet with links to artifacts and send to GlossyBank for review. ETA: Friday 4pm PT.
Sam (AE): :thumbsup: thanks all. @Raj can you drop the redaction script and sample log file in the share? Also include the SOC2 report excerpt for logging control.
Raj (SRE): Done — uploaded redact_logs.py and cloudtrail-sample-redacted.json to the folder.
Tina (SecOps): Uploading rotation pdf now. Also note: Q12 asked about KMS key rotation automation — we use AWS schedule + Lambda in dedicated, and CMK policy enforced by rotation flag in managed. I'll add the automation snippet: `aws kms rotate-key --key-id <key-id>`
Sam (AE): Great. If anyone sees blockers ping me. I'll schedule a quick 15m review with GlossyBank Monday AM to walk them through docs.
